postpartumSigns.en: Heavy bleeding (a pad soaked in under an hour)
postpartumSigns.sw: Kutokwa damu nyingi (pedi inalowa chini ya saa moja)
Kichwa kuuma sana au kuona ukungu

postpartumSigns.en: Hard to breathe or chest pain
postpartumSigns.sw: Kupumua kwa shida au maumivu ya kifua
Titi kuuma, jekundu au la moto

postpartumSigns.en: Very sad or hopeless most days
postpartumSigns.sw: Huzuni kubwa au kukata tamaa siku nyingi

postpartumSigns.en: Thoughts of harming myself or my baby
postpartumSigns.sw: Mawazo ya kujidhuru au kumdhuru mtoto

babySigns.en: Not able to breastfeed or drink
Diarrhoea with blood, or sunken eyes
babySigns.sw: Kuharisha damu, au macho yameingia ndani

babySigns.en: Red or smelly cord, or pus

babySigns.sw: Nepi chache zenye mkojo kuliko kawaida

babySigns.en: Yellow palms or soles, or yellow on the first day of life
babySigns.sw: Viganja au nyayo za njano, au njano siku ya kwanza ya maisha

babySigns.en: Swollen, hard belly or green vomit
babySigns.sw: Tumbo limevimba na gumu, au matapishi ya kijani
Kucheua maziwa kidogo baada ya kunyonya

babySigns.en: Crying or fussy more than usual

items: Confirm where you will give birth
Plan if no labour by 41 weeks

baby.en: Baby is a tiny cluster of cells settling into the womb. The heart and spine start to form.
baby.sw: Mtoto ni kundi dogo la seli linalojishikiza tumboni. Moyo na uti wa mgongo vinaanza kuumbika.

you.en: Your period stops. You may feel tired or sick. Start folic acid and book your first antenatal visit.
you.sw: Hedhi inakoma. Unaweza kuchoka au kuhisi kichefuchefu. Anza vidonge vya foliki na panga kliniki ya kwanza.

baby.en: The heart beats. Arms, legs and face begin to form.
baby.sw: Moyo unadunda. Mikono, miguu na uso vinaanza kuumbika.

you.en: Nausea and tender breasts are common. Eat small meals often.
you.sw: Kichefuchefu na matiti kuuma ni kawaida. Kula kidogo mara nyingi.

baby.en: All the organs have formed. Baby moves, but you cannot feel it yet.
baby.sw: Viungo vyote vimeumbika. Mtoto anasogea lakini bado huhisi.

you.en: Go to your first antenatal visit by 12 weeks. Nausea often eases soon.
you.sw: Hudhuria kliniki ya kwanza kabla ya wiki 12. Kichefuchefu hupungua hivi karibuni.

baby.en: Baby can hear sounds. Hair and nails are growing.
baby.sw: Mtoto anasikia sauti. Nywele na kucha zinaota.

you.en: Energy often returns. Keep taking your iron and folic acid tablet.
you.sw: Nguvu mara nyingi hurudi. Endelea kumeza kidonge cha madini ya chuma na foliki.

baby.en: You may feel the first movements, like small flutters.
baby.sw: Unaweza kuhisi mtoto akicheza kwa mara ya kwanza.

you.en: Your belly shows. Start sleeping on your side.
you.sw: Tumbo linaonekana. Anza kulala kwa ubavu.

baby.en: Baby's lungs are developing and baby reacts to your voice.
baby.sw: Mapafu ya mtoto yanakua na anaitikia sauti yako.

you.en: Back pain and heartburn are common. Rest and eat smaller meals.
you.sw: Maumivu ya mgongo na kiungulia ni kawaida. Pumzika na kula milo midogo.

baby.en: Baby opens their eyes and puts on fat.
baby.sw: Mtoto anafumbua macho na kuongeza mafuta mwilini.

you.en: Notice baby’s movements every day. Watch for headache, swelling or blurred vision.
you.sw: Fuatilia mateke ya mtoto kila siku. Angalia kichwa kuuma, kuvimba au kuona ukungu.

baby.en: Baby grows fast and usually turns head-down.
baby.sw: Mtoto anakua haraka na kwa kawaida hugeuka kichwa chini.

you.en: Finish your birth plan and learn the signs of labour.
you.sw: Kamilisha mpango wa kujifungua na jifunze dalili za uchungu.

baby.en: Baby is getting ready to be born.

you.en: Keep your bag ready. Go to the facility when labour starts or your water breaks.
you.sw: Weka begi tayari. Nenda kituoni uchungu ukianza au chupa ikipasuka.

title.sw: Dalili za hatari wakati wa ujauzito

en: Bleeding from the vagina: go to the facility now.
Severe headache, blurred vision or fits: go now.
Swollen face or hands with headache or blurred vision, or severe belly pain: go now.
Water leaking: go now. Fever, or baby moving less: see a health worker today.
sw: Kutokwa damu ukeni: nenda kituoni sasa.
Kichwa kuuma sana, kuona ukungu au degedege: nenda sasa.
Uso au mikono kuvimba pamoja na kichwa kuuma au kuona ukungu, au maumivu makali ya tumbo: nenda sasa.
Maji kutoka: nenda sasa. Homa, au mtoto kucheza kidogo: muone mhudumu wa afya leo.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience
WHO Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care: a guide for essential practice (3rd ed.)

en: Choose the facility where you will give birth.
Plan transport and save money for the journey.
Choose a birth companion and someone to care for your home.
Pack clean cloths, baby clothes and your clinic card.
sw: Chagua kituo utakachojifungulia.
Panga usafiri na weka akiba ya nauli.
Chagua msindikizaji na mtu wa kutunza nyumbani.
Andaa vitambaa safi, nguo za mtoto na kadi ya kliniki.

sources.title: WHO Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care: a guide for essential practice (3rd ed.)
WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience

en: From about 28 weeks, notice your baby's movements every day.
Lie on your left side after a meal and notice the kicks, rolls and swishes. There is no number to reach.
Learn your baby's usual pattern.
If movements are fewer than usual or stop, contact a health worker today. Do not wait until tomorrow.
sw: Kuanzia wiki 28, fuatilia mateke ya mtoto kila siku.
Lala kwa ubavu wa kushoto baada ya kula na fuatilia mateke na mizunguko. Hakuna idadi ya kufikia.
Jifunze mtindo wa kawaida wa mtoto wako.
Mateke yakipungua au kukoma, wasiliana na mhudumu wa afya leo. Usisubiri kesho.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience

en: Regular, painful tightenings that get stronger and closer together.
A show of mucus with a little blood.
Your water breaks: go to the facility, even without pain.
Heavy bleeding is not normal labour: go now.
sw: Maumivu ya tumbo yanayokuja kwa mpangilio na kuongezeka.
Ute wenye damu kidogo.
Chupa ikipasuka: nenda kituoni hata bila maumivu.
Damu nyingi si uchungu wa kawaida: nenda sasa.

sources.title: WHO recommendations: intrapartum care for a positive childbirth experience
WHO Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care: a guide for essential practice (3rd ed.)

title.en: Eating well, the East African way
title.sw: Lishe bora kwa vyakula vya nyumbani

en: Add beans, lentils or groundnuts to one meal every day.
Eat dark green leaves like mchicha or sukuma wiki.
Small fish like dagaa give protein and calcium.
Eat a fruit with meals to help your body use iron.
sw: Ongeza maharage, dengu au karanga kwenye mlo mmoja kila siku.
Kula mboga za majani kama mchicha au sukuma wiki.
Samaki wadogo kama dagaa wana protini na kalsiamu.
Kula tunda pamoja na chakula kusaidia mwili kutumia madini ya chuma.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience

title.sw: Vidonge vya madini ya chuma na foliki

en: Take one tablet every day, as your clinic prescribed.
Take it with water or juice, not with tea or coffee.
Dark stools are normal. Mild nausea often passes.
If you forget a day, continue the next day. Do not take two.
sw: Meza kidonge kimoja kila siku, kama kliniki ilivyokuandikia.
Meza kwa maji au juisi, si kwa chai au kahawa.
Choo cheusi ni kawaida. Kichefuchefu kidogo hupita.
Ukisahau siku moja, endelea kesho. Usimeze viwili.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience

title.en: Feeling low in pregnancy or after birth
title.sw: Huzuni wakati wa ujauzito au baada ya kujifungua

en: Many mothers feel tired, worried or tearful. You are not alone.
Talk to someone you trust, and rest when you can.
If you feel very sad for more than two weeks, tell your health worker.
If you have thoughts of harming yourself or your baby, get help today.
sw: Akina mama wengi huchoka, huwa na wasiwasi au hulia. Hauko peke yako.
Ongea na mtu unayemwamini, na pumzika unapoweza.
Ukihisi huzuni kubwa kwa zaidi ya wiki mbili, mwambie mhudumu wa afya.
Ukiwa na mawazo ya kujidhuru au kumdhuru mtoto, tafuta msaada leo.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on maternal and newborn care for a positive postnatal experience
WHO Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care: a guide for essential practice (3rd ed.)

en: Hold baby skin-to-skin and start breastfeeding within one hour of birth.
The first yellow milk (colostrum) protects your baby.
Give breast milk only, with no water or other food, until 6 months.
Feed whenever baby wants, day and night, at least 8 times a day.
sw: Mweke mtoto ngozi kwa ngozi na anza kunyonyesha ndani ya saa moja baada ya kuzaliwa.
Maziwa ya kwanza ya njano yanamkinga mtoto.
Mpe maziwa ya mama pekee, bila maji wala chakula kingine, hadi miezi 6.
Nyonyesha kila mtoto anapotaka, mchana na usiku, angalau mara 8 kwa siku.

sources.title: WHO/UNICEF Infant and young child feeding counselling: an integrated course (2nd ed.)
WHO recommendations on maternal and newborn care for a positive postnatal experience

en: Baby's chin touches the breast and the mouth is wide open.
More of the dark area shows above the lip than below.
You hear slow, deep sucks and swallowing.
Pain or cracked nipples: ask a health worker to check the attachment.
sw: Kidevu cha mtoto kinagusa titi na mdomo uko wazi.
Sehemu nyeusi ya titi inaonekana zaidi juu ya mdomo kuliko chini.
Unasikia mivuto ya polepole na kumeza.
Maumivu au chuchu kupasuka: muombe mhudumu wa afya aangalie unavyonyonyesha.

sources.title: WHO/UNICEF Infant and young child feeding counselling: an integrated course (2nd ed.)

en: At 6 months, keep breastfeeding and add soft foods.
Start with thick porridge (uji) with groundnut or dagaa powder.
Add mashed banana, avocado, pumpkin and well-cooked beans.
Wash hands and use a clean cup and spoon. Avoid feeding bottles.
sw: Akifikisha miezi 6, endelea kunyonyesha na ongeza vyakula laini.
Anza na uji mzito ulioongezwa unga wa karanga au dagaa.
Ongeza ndizi, parachichi, maboga na maharage yaliyopondwa.
Nawa mikono na tumia kikombe na kijiko safi. Epuka chupa.

sources.title: WHO guideline for complementary feeding of infants and young children 6–23 months of age

en: Dry baby straight after birth and hold them skin-to-skin.
Dress baby in one more layer than you, with a hat.
Wait at least 24 hours before the first bath.
Cold hands, feet and body: warm baby and see a health worker today.
sw: Mkaushe mtoto mara baada ya kuzaliwa na mkumbatie ngozi kwa ngozi.
Mvalishe mtoto nguo moja zaidi yako, na kofia.
Subiri angalau saa 24 kabla ya kumwogesha mara ya kwanza.
Mikono, miguu na mwili wa baridi: mpe joto na muone mhudumu wa afya leo.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on maternal and newborn care for a positive postnatal experience
WHO Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care: a guide for essential practice (3rd ed.)

en: Keep the cord clean and dry. Wash your hands before touching it.
Do not put anything on the cord.
Fold the nappy below the cord.
Redness, pus or a bad smell: see a health worker today.
sw: Weka kitovu kisafi na kikavu. Nawa mikono kabla ya kukigusa.
Usiweke kitu chochote kwenye kitovu.
Kunja nepi chini ya kitovu.
Wekundu, usaha au harufu mbaya: muone mhudumu wa afya leo.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on maternal and newborn care for a positive postnatal experience

en: Not able to breastfeed, or vomiting everything.
Fits, or very sleepy and hard to wake.
Fast breathing, or the chest pulling in.
Fever or feeling cold, especially before 2 months: go to the facility now.
sw: Hawezi kunyonya, au anatapika kila kitu.
Degedege, au amelegea na ni vigumu kumwamsha.
Anapumua haraka, au kifua kinavutika ndani.
Homa au baridi, hasa kabla ya miezi 2: nenda kituoni sasa.

sources.title: WHO Integrated Management of Childhood Illness chart booklet
WHO recommendations on maternal and newborn care for a positive postnatal experience

en: Wash hands with soap after the toilet and before feeding or cooking.
Boil or treat drinking water for the family.
Keep baby's cups, spoons and cloths clean.
Sleep under a treated mosquito net with your baby.
sw: Nawa mikono kwa sabuni baada ya choo na kabla ya kulisha au kupika.
Chemsha au tibu maji ya kunywa ya familia.
Weka vikombe, vijiko na vitambaa vya mtoto safi.
Lala na mtoto ndani ya chandarua chenye dawa.

sources.title: WHO Integrated Management of Childhood Illness chart booklet

en: Waiting at least 2 years before the next pregnancy is healthier for you and your baby.
Breastfeeding alone is not reliable protection after 6 months or once your period returns.
Ask about family planning at your postnatal or child clinic visit.
Many methods are safe while breastfeeding.
sw: Kusubiri angalau miaka 2 kabla ya ujauzito mwingine ni bora kwako na kwa mtoto.
Kunyonyesha pekee si kinga ya kuaminika baada ya miezi 6 au hedhi ikirudi.
Uliza kuhusu uzazi wa mpango kliniki ya baada ya kujifungua au ya mtoto.
Njia nyingi ni salama wakati wa kunyonyesha.

sources.title: Report of a WHO technical consultation on birth spacing
WHO recommendations on maternal and newborn care for a positive postnatal experience

en: From 28 weeks, go to sleep on your side, left or right.
If you wake up on your back, just turn onto your side.
Sleep under a treated mosquito net every night.
Rest in the shade in the day when you can.
sw: Kuanzia wiki 28, lala kwa ubavu, kushoto au kulia.
Ukiamka umelala chali, geuka tu ulale kwa ubavu.
Lala ndani ya chandarua chenye dawa kila usiku.
Pumzika kivulini mchana unapoweza.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience

title.sw: Shinikizo la damu wakati wa ujauzito

en: High blood pressure can come with no signs at all. Have it measured.
140/90 or higher: see a health worker within 24 hours.
High blood pressure with headache, blurred vision, pain under the ribs or a swollen face: go now.
From 20 weeks, have it measured every week by your CHW or clinic.
sw: Shinikizo la juu linaweza kuja bila dalili yoyote. Pimwa.
140/90 au zaidi: muone mhudumu wa afya ndani ya saa 24.
Shinikizo la juu pamoja na kichwa kuuma, kuona ukungu, maumivu chini ya mbavu au uso kuvimba: nenda sasa.
Kuanzia wiki 20, pimwa kila wiki na mhudumu wa jamii au kliniki.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience
WHO Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care: a guide for essential practice (3rd ed.)

en: Cradle hold: baby's whole body faces you, ear, shoulder and hip in a line.
Cross-cradle hold: your other arm supports the neck and shoulders. Good for newborns.
Lying on your side helps after a caesarean or at night. Keep pillows away from baby.
Twins: hold one baby under each arm, on a pillow.
sw: Mkao wa kubeba: mwili wote wa mtoto unakuelekea, sikio, bega na nyonga katika mstari mmoja.
Mkao wa kubeba kwa mkono mwingine: mkono wako mwingine unashika shingo na mabega. Unafaa kwa watoto wachanga.
Kulala kwa ubavu kunasaidia baada ya upasuaji au usiku. Weka mito mbali na mtoto.
Mapacha: beba mtoto mmoja chini ya kila mkono, juu ya mto.

sources.title: WHO/UNICEF Infant and young child feeding counselling: an integrated course (2nd ed.)

en: Wash your hands and use a clean, wide cup.
Put your thumb and finger at the edge of the dark area, press back, then together. Do not squeeze the nipple.
Cover the milk and keep it cool. Use it within 6 hours.
Feed from a small open cup, with baby sitting up. Do not use a bottle.
sw: Nawa mikono na tumia kikombe kisafi na kipana.
Weka kidole gumba na kidole kingine pembeni mwa sehemu nyeusi, bonyeza kuelekea ndani, kisha bana. Usibane chuchu.
Funika maziwa na yaweke mahali penye ubaridi. Yatumie ndani ya saa 6.
Mlishe kwa kikombe kidogo kilicho wazi, mtoto akiwa amekaa wima. Usitumie chupa.

sources.title: WHO/UNICEF Infant and young child feeding counselling: an integrated course (2nd ed.)

en: Lay baby on the back for every sleep, on a firm, flat place.
Keep pillows, toys and heavy blankets away from baby's face.
Keep baby close, in the same room, under a treated net.
Nobody smokes in the house or near baby.
sw: Mlaze mtoto chali kila anapolala, mahali pagumu na tambarare.
Weka mito, vitu vya kuchezea na blanketi nzito mbali na uso wa mtoto.
Mweke mtoto karibu, chumba kimoja nawe, ndani ya chandarua chenye dawa.
Mtu yeyote asivute sigara ndani ya nyumba wala karibu na mtoto.

title.sw: Malezi ya kangaruu kwa watoto wadogo

en: A small or early baby stays warm best skin-to-skin, upright on your chest, in a nappy and hat.
Tie a kanga around you both so baby is held safely, face free.
Your partner or a grandmother can take turns.
Breastfeed often, at least every 2 to 3 hours.
sw: Mtoto mdogo au aliyezaliwa kabla ya wakati hupata joto zaidi akiwa ngozi kwa ngozi, wima kifuani kwako, akiwa na nepi na kofia.
Funga kanga kuwazunguka wote wawili ili mtoto akae salama, uso wazi.
Mwenzako au bibi anaweza kupokezana nawe.
Mnyonyeshe mara nyingi, angalau kila saa 2 hadi 3.

sources.title: WHO recommendations for care of the preterm or low-birth-weight infant

birthReadiness.en: Clean cloths and baby clothes packed
birthReadiness.sw: Vitambaa safi na nguo za mtoto vimeandaliwa
Kadi ya kliniki iko kwenye begi

birthReadiness.en: Treated mosquito net ready for baby
birthReadiness.sw: Chandarua chenye dawa kiko tayari kwa mtoto

assistantIntents.en: Thank you for telling me. Thoughts of harming yourself or your baby are a sign you need support today, and help works. Please go to the health facility now or call your health worker, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
assistantIntents.sw: Asante kwa kuniambia. Mawazo ya kujidhuru au kumdhuru mtoto ni ishara kwamba unahitaji msaada leo, na msaada unasaidia. Tafadhali nenda kituo cha afya sasa au mpigie mhudumu wako wa afya, na muombe mtu unayemwamini akae nawe.

assistantIntents.en: Blood pressure of 140/90 or more needs a health worker within 24 hours. 160/110 or more, or 140/90 with a severe headache, blurred vision, pain high in the belly or swelling, means go to the facility now. Log your weekly reading on the Health tab so a slow rise is noticed.
assistantIntents.sw: Shinikizo la damu la 140/90 au zaidi linahitaji mhudumu wa afya ndani ya saa 24. 160/110 au zaidi, au 140/90 pamoja na kichwa kuuma sana, kuona ukungu, maumivu juu ya tumbo au kuvimba, nenda kituoni sasa. Andika kipimo chako cha kila wiki kwenye Afya ili kupanda polepole kugundulike.

assistantIntents.en: Bleeding from the vagina in pregnancy, or heavy bleeding after birth, needs urgent care. Go to the health facility now and ask someone to go with you.
assistantIntents.sw: Kutokwa damu ukeni wakati wa ujauzito, au damu nyingi baada ya kujifungua, kunahitaji huduma ya haraka. Nenda kituo cha afya sasa na muombe mtu akusindikize.

assistantIntents.en: Fits in a mother or a baby are an emergency. Go to the health facility now. Keep the person on their side and do not put anything in their mouth.
assistantIntents.sw: Degedege kwa mama au mtoto ni dharura. Nenda kituo cha afya sasa. Mlaze upande mmoja na usiweke kitu mdomoni.

assistantIntents.en: Fast or difficult breathing, or a chest that pulls in, needs urgent care. Go to the health facility now.
assistantIntents.sw: Kupumua haraka au kwa shida, au kifua kuvutika ndani, kunahitaji huduma ya haraka. Nenda kituo cha afya sasa.

assistantIntents.en: A severe headache, especially with blurred vision or swelling, can be a sign of high blood pressure in pregnancy or after birth. Go to the facility now to have your blood pressure checked.
assistantIntents.sw: Kichwa kuuma sana, hasa pamoja na kuona ukungu au kuvimba, kunaweza kuwa dalili ya shinikizo la damu wakati wa ujauzito au baada ya kujifungua. Nenda kituoni sasa kupimwa shinikizo la damu.

assistantIntents.en: A baby under 2 months with a fever needs care now: go to the health facility. An older baby with a fever should see a health worker today, and sooner if they cannot feed, are very sleepy or have fits. Keep breastfeeding often. A mother with a fever should also see a health worker today.
assistantIntents.sw: Mtoto chini ya miezi 2 mwenye homa anahitaji huduma sasa: nenda kituo cha afya. Mtoto mkubwa zaidi mwenye homa aonwe na mhudumu wa afya leo, na mapema zaidi kama hawezi kunyonya, amelegea au ana degedege. Endelea kunyonyesha mara kwa mara. Mama mwenye homa pia aonwe na mhudumu wa afya leo.

assistantIntents.en: Noticing your baby's movements every day helps you learn their pattern. If movements are fewer than usual or have stopped, contact a health worker today. Do not wait until tomorrow.
assistantIntents.sw: Kufuatilia mateke ya mtoto kila siku kunakusaidia kujua mtindo wake. Mateke yakipungua au kukoma, wasiliana na mhudumu wa afya leo. Usisubiri kesho.

assistantIntents.en: Yellow skin or eyes in a baby should be checked by a health worker today. Go now if the baby is less than a day old, if the palms or soles are yellow, or if the baby is not feeding well.
assistantIntents.sw: Ngozi au macho ya njano kwa mtoto yachunguzwe na mhudumu wa afya leo. Nenda sasa kama mtoto ana chini ya siku moja, viganja au nyayo ni njano, au hanyonyi vizuri.

assistantIntents.en: Many mothers feel low or worried, and it is not your fault. Rest when you can and talk to someone you trust. If you have felt very sad for more than two weeks, tell your health worker. They can help.
assistantIntents.sw: Akina mama wengi huhisi huzuni au wasiwasi, na si kosa lako. Pumzika unapoweza na ongea na mtu unayemwamini. Ukihisi huzuni kubwa kwa zaidi ya wiki mbili, mwambie mhudumu wa afya. Wanaweza kukusaidia.

assistantIntents.en: Babies cry to say they are hungry, tired, wet or want to be held. Try a feed, a clean nappy, skin-to-skin and gentle rocking. If the cry sounds very different from usual, or comes with fever or poor feeding, see a health worker today.
assistantIntents.sw: Watoto hulia kuonyesha njaa, uchovu, unyevu au kutaka kubebwa. Jaribu kunyonyesha, nepi safi, ngozi kwa ngozi na kumbembeleza. Kilio kikiwa tofauti sana na kawaida, au pamoja na homa au kutonyonya vizuri, muone mhudumu wa afya leo.

assistantIntents.en: Breast milk alone gives your baby all the food and water they need until 6 months. Feed whenever baby wants, at least 8 times a day. Good attachment means a wide-open mouth and slow, deep sucks. If feeding hurts, ask a health worker to check the attachment.
assistantIntents.sw: Maziwa ya mama pekee yanampa mtoto chakula na maji yote anayohitaji hadi miezi 6. Nyonyesha kila mtoto anapotaka, angalau mara 8 kwa siku. Kunyonya vizuri ni mdomo wazi na mivuto ya polepole. Ikiuma, muombe mhudumu wa afya aangalie.

assistantIntents.en: Lay your baby on their back to sleep, on a firm surface, in your room and under a treated mosquito net. Keep blankets away from the face.
assistantIntents.sw: Mlaze mtoto chali, mahali pagumu, chumbani mwako na ndani ya chandarua chenye dawa. Weka blanketi mbali na uso wake.

assistantIntents.en: Vaccines protect your baby from serious illness. Bring the child health card to every visit. You can see the next due date under My Baby and in Visits.
assistantIntents.sw: Chanjo zinamkinga mtoto dhidi ya magonjwa hatari. Beba kadi ya kliniki ya mtoto kila unapoenda. Tarehe ya chanjo ijayo iko kwenye Mtoto wangu na Kliniki.

assistantIntents.en: Keep the cord clean and dry and put nothing on it. Fold the nappy below it. Redness, pus or a bad smell needs a health worker today.
assistantIntents.sw: Weka kitovu kisafi na kikavu na usiweke kitu chochote. Kunja nepi chini yake. Wekundu, usaha au harufu mbaya: muone mhudumu wa afya leo.

assistantIntents.en: Try to include beans or groundnuts, dark green leaves and small fish like dagaa each day, with a fruit to help your body use iron. Take your iron and folic acid tablet as prescribed.
assistantIntents.sw: Jaribu kula maharage au karanga, mboga za majani na samaki wadogo kama dagaa kila siku, pamoja na tunda kusaidia mwili kutumia madini ya chuma. Meza kidonge cha madini ya chuma na foliki kama ulivyoandikiwa.

assistantIntents.en: Waiting at least 2 years before your next pregnancy is healthier for you and your baby. Many family planning methods are safe while breastfeeding. Ask at your next postnatal or child clinic visit.
assistantIntents.sw: Kusubiri angalau miaka 2 kabla ya ujauzito mwingine ni bora kwako na kwa mtoto. Njia nyingi za uzazi wa mpango ni salama wakati wa kunyonyesha. Uliza kliniki ijayo.

assistantDefault.en: I can help with questions about pregnancy, getting ready for birth, feeding and caring for your baby. Try one of the suggestions below, or add your question to your list for the next visit.
assistantDefault.sw: Ninaweza kusaidia kwa maswali kuhusu ujauzito, maandalizi ya kujifungua, ulishaji na matunzo ya mtoto. Jaribu mojawapo ya mapendekezo hapa chini, au ongeza swali lako kwenye orodha ya kliniki ijayo.
